FAQs

Hair Colour

Still have questions?

Ask us on WhatsApp

  • Global hair colour is one even shade applied to all of your hair, from the roots to the ends. It is the go-to choice for full grey coverage, refreshing faded colour or a complete colour change, and it suits every hair length for both women and men. View Details

  • Yes, Xing offers ammonia-free global colour and ammonia-free root touch-ups at all three salons in Sarjapur Road, HSR Layout and Brookfield. It is a popular, gentler option. Your colourist will tell you during the consultation whether it can reach the shade you want. View Details

  • Highlights are lighter strands placed with foils for brighter, more defined dimension, while balayage is painted by hand for a softer, blended finish. Highlights look crisper and more even; balayage grows out more gradually. Your colourist can combine both if you want brightness with a soft root. View Details

  • Yes, you can book highlights per foil at Xing. It is perfect for face-framing pieces, a few bright strands around the parting or a subtle pop of colour. Your colourist will suggest how many foils you need during your free consultation at Sarjapur Road, HSR Layout or Brookfield. View Details

  • Balayage lasts a long time because it grows out softly, without a sharp regrowth line. Many clients refresh it only every three to four months. A toner between visits keeps the tone fresh, and colour-safe shampoo plus regular hair spas keep your lengths glossy and healthy. View Details

  • Yes, balayage looks beautiful on dark Indian hair. Caramel, honey, chocolate and bronze tones blend naturally with a dark base. Your colourist will recommend a shade that suits your skin tone, and may suggest building lighter colour over two visits to keep your hair healthy. View Details

  • Usually yes. Bright and pastel shades need lighter hair underneath to show true, especially on dark Indian hair. Your colourist pre-lightens only the sections that need it and adds bond protection, so your hair stays as strong as possible. Darker vivid shades sometimes need less lightening. View Details

  • Vivid and pastel colours fade faster than natural shades, often within four to eight weeks, depending on the shade and how often you wash. Wash with cool water, use a sulphate-free shampoo and avoid too much heat to keep the colour bright for longer. View Details

FAQs

Smoothing & Treatments

Still have questions?

Ask us on WhatsApp

  • A keratin treatment usually stays smooth and frizz-free for a few months, softening gradually rather than stopping suddenly. How long it lasts depends on your hair type, how often you wash and your aftercare. Sulphate-free shampoo and regular hair spas help your results last longer. View Details

  • No, keratin mainly removes frizz and adds shine while keeping your hair’s natural body and movement. Wavy hair becomes smoother and easier to style, but not poker-straight. If you want straight hair, ask your stylist about hair smoothening or hair straightening instead. View Details

  • Smoothening relaxes waves and curls into straighter hair, while keratin mainly removes frizz and adds shine and keeps your natural volume. Smoothening gives a sleeker, more lasting change to your texture. Your stylist will recommend the right one after checking your hair at Xing. View Details

  • Hair smoothening lasts on the treated hair until it grows out or is cut, while new growth comes in with your natural texture. Most people book a root touch-up every four to six months. Sulphate-free shampoo and regular hair spas keep smoothened hair soft. View Details

  • Neither is better for everyone. Nanoplastia gives a smoother, noticeably straighter finish, while keratin keeps more of your natural volume and mainly controls frizz. During a free consultation at Xing, your stylist looks at your texture and goals and recommends the one that suits your hair. View Details

  • Cysteine tames frizz and improves manageability while keeping your natural movement. Nanoplastia goes further, giving frizzy, wavy or curly hair a silky, noticeably straighter finish that is easy to style. Your stylist checks your hair first and recommends the option that matches your goals. View Details

  • It is suited to clients who want help with colour or heat-stressed hair. Your stylist will assess your hair and recommend the right option during a free consultation. View Details

  • Yes. You can book at Xing Sarjapur Road, HSR Layout or Brookfield in Bangalore. View Details

FAQs

Gift Cards & Membership

Still have questions?

Ask us on WhatsApp

  • At Xing, online on this page or at our Sarjapur Road, HSR Layout and Brookfield salons. Choose an occasion card or a value card, add a personal message, and we deliver it instantly on WhatsApp or email, or as a printed card. View Details

  • You prepay once and we add 10% to 25% bonus value depending on your tier. Use the balance for eligible hair, skin and nail services at any Xing salon until it expires. Our team confirms your tier value and eligible services on WhatsApp or at the salon before you pay, so there are no surprises. View Details

  • Most clients choose Xing Gold: 18% bonus value, 12-month validity, priority weekend slots and sharing with one family member. Choose Privé for maximum value and family sharing, or Glow if you are trying membership for the first time and visit a little less often. View Details

  • Yes, gift cards and memberships work at all three Xing salons in Bangalore. Use them at Sarjapur Road, HSR Layout or Brookfield for eligible hair, skin and nail services, and switch between salons whenever it suits you. We confirm the details with you before every service starts. View Details

  • A Xing gift card is valid for 12 months from the date it is issued. The person you gift it to can book any time in that year at Sarjapur Road, HSR Layout or Brookfield, and our team confirms every detail with them before the service starts. View Details

  • Yes. We send a personalised e-card with your message on WhatsApp or email, on the date you choose. You can also collect a printed card at any Xing salon. Just share the recipient’s name and the delivery date in the form, and our team confirms everything with you on WhatsApp. View Details

  • Yes. For 10 or more cards we add your company logo to the e-card and provide a single invoice. Your team can use their cards at any of our three Bangalore salons, and we deliver every e-card on WhatsApp or email on the date you choose. View Details

  • Gold covers one family member and Privé covers two, registered at purchase. Glow is for the member only. Family members use the same balance at any Xing salon in Bangalore, so a parent, partner or sibling can book their own hair, skin and nail services. View Details

  • Our “For Amma” gift card: hair spa, pedicure and a relaxing head massage at a Xing salon near her. She can visit Sarjapur Road, HSR Layout or Brookfield, and we deliver the card with your personal message on WhatsApp, by email or as a printed card. View Details

  • A gift card is for gifting someone else; membership is for yourself and saves the most if you visit once a month or more. Membership adds 10% to 25% bonus value to every visit, while a gift card comes with an occasion perk and a personal message. View Details
